schemes.title: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
schemes.description: Direct income support of Rs.6,000 per year to small and marginal farmer families having combined landholding upto 2 hectares.
schemes.benefits: Rs.6,000 per year in 3 installments of Rs.2,000 each directly to bank accounts
schemes.eligibility: Small and marginal farmer families with combined land holding up to 2 hectares
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply at nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or visit pmkisan.gov.in
schemes.documents: Aadhaar card, Land records, Bank account details

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana
schemes.description: Housing for All mission to provide affordable housing to urban poor.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.beneficiaries: Urban Poor, EWS, LIG, MIG households
schemes.benefits: Subsidy up to Rs.2.67 lakh on home loans, Direct subsidy for house construction
schemes.eligibility: Annual household income below Rs.18 lakh, No pucca house in India
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply through pmaymis.gov.in or nearest Urban Local Body office
schemes.documents: Aadhaar, Income certificate, Property documents, Bank account

schemes.title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
schemes.description: World largest health insurance scheme providing coverage of Rs.5 lakh per family per year.
schemes.benefits: Rs.5 lakh health cover per family per year for hospitalization
schemes.eligibility: Families listed in SECC database 2011 or state schemes
schemes.how_to_apply: Visit nearest empanelled hospital or Common Service Centre with Aadhaar
schemes.documents: Aadhaar card, Ration card or SECC document

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
schemes.description: Micro-credit scheme for non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
schemes.benefits: Loans up to Rs.10 lakh without collateral
schemes.eligibility: Non-farm income generating activities, manufacturing, trading or service sector
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply at any bank, MFI, or visit mudra.org.in
schemes.documents: Identity proof, Address proof, Business plan, Bank statements

schemes.title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
schemes.description: Small savings scheme for girl child to meet education and marriage expenses.
schemes.benefits: 8.2% interest rate, Tax exemption under 80C, Partial withdrawal at age 18
schemes.eligibility: Girl child below 10 years, Account opened by parent/guardian
schemes.how_to_apply: Open account at any post office or authorized bank with minimum Rs.250/year
schemes.documents: Birth certificate of girl child, Parents Aadhaar, Address proof

schemes.title: National Scholarship Portal
schemes.description: Centralized portal for scholarships for SC, ST, OBC, minority students.
schemes.benefits: Scholarships ranging from Rs.1,000 to Rs.25,000 per annum
schemes.eligibility: Students from SC/ST/OBC/Minority, enrolled in recognized institutions
schemes.how_to_apply: Register at scholarships.gov.in and apply before deadline
schemes.documents: Aadhaar, Caste certificate, Income certificate, Marksheets, Bank account

schemes.title: PM Ujjwala Yojana
schemes.description: LPG connections to women from Below Poverty Line families.
schemes.benefits: Free LPG connection with first refill and stove
schemes.eligibility: Women above 18 years from BPL family, No existing LPG connection
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply at nearest LPG distributor with documents
schemes.documents: BPL ration card, Aadhaar, Bank account, Address proof

schemes.title: Atal Pension Yojana
schemes.description: Pension scheme for unorganised sector workers guaranteeing fixed pension after 60.
schemes.benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs.1,000 to Rs.5,000 after age 60
schemes.eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18-40 with savings bank account
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply at any bank branch where you have savings account

schemes.title: Skill India PMKVY
schemes.description: Free short-term skill training to Indian youth with certification reward.
schemes.benefits: Free skill training, Rs.8,000 reward on certification, placement assistance
schemes.eligibility: Indian citizens aged 15-45, school or college dropouts
schemes.how_to_apply: Register at skillindia.gov.in or visit nearest PMKVY training centre

schemes.title: PM Jan Dhan Yojana
schemes.description: Financial inclusion scheme providing universal banking access to unbanked citizens.
schemes.benefits: Zero-balance bank account, RuPay debit card, Rs.2 lakh accident insurance
schemes.eligibility: Any Indian citizen above 10 years without a bank account
schemes.how_to_apply: Visit any bank branch or Business Correspondent with documents
schemes.documents: Aadhaar or any official identity proof

schemes.title: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
schemes.description: National campaign to address declining Child Sex Ratio and empowerment of women.
schemes.benefits: Educational support, awareness programs, skill development for girls
schemes.eligibility: Girl children across India, priority in select districts
schemes.how_to_apply: Contact nearest Anganwadi centre or district Women & Child Development office

schemes.title: PM SVANidhi Street Vendor Loan
schemes.description: Affordable working capital loan to street vendors affected by COVID-19.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.benefits: Initial loan of Rs.10,000 expandable to Rs.50,000 without collateral
schemes.eligibility: Street vendors with Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply online at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or at nearby bank
